title: Overcoming Fairness Trade-offs via Pre-processing: A Causal Perspective
reasoning: The paper focuses on resolving fairness trade-offs in general machine learning (using gradient boosted trees and tabular data) from a causal perspective. While it uses normative fairness and references philosophical concepts (Aristotle) to establish its theoretical framework, it does not benchmark or evaluate religion, morality, or ethics as a primary component, nor does it address LLMs or NLP systems.
